# readmsi

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

readmsi is a package to make working with CLC MSI outputs easier.

## Installation

You can install the development version of readmsi from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("joe-m-shaw/readmsi")
```
